author: vladthegreat100
body:
So pretty much my rant of the day is to remove the Auto Join (If you were previously playing).
1. You don't get to choose your team unless you /leave. Yea, doesn't take much but what about the players who aren't donors? By the time they leave the people who were waiting last game stole their spot and they have to wait or change servers. Just make people do /join or /join [Team Colour] and put them as spectator afterwards when the game is done like the old days.
2. Auto Join is bad if you go afk, especially after the game for a bit. Luckly I was not gone for a bit but I was getting spawnkilled, there was a mod in game (Not Naming) and he didn't notice, no one I'm guessing was fast enough at typing to write a report, but when I did the mod got them to stop luckly. It ended up making lose 0.04 KD (Not much but I praise my KD xd). This was my kill log:

10 deaths in 3 minutes, 5 deaths in 1 minute, and don't get me wrong, people CAN get kills like this except this was awarriorvenom's nexus map (with the multiple levels made of wood, really big). And it was the same people. Not fun, removing auto join could stop the farming off AFK people (Its allowed) but break the rules and spawn kill at the same time.

Hope you guys do take this suggestion in consideration.
Best Regards!
Vlad :)

title: [SUG] Remove Auto Join in Games

replies.author: Tarheelkiwi
replies.body: I 1000000000000000% agree.  I never liked this.  Another example is when a Mod is spectating a match and once the match is over, he/she would have to type /leave.  Now I am not a Mod and I don't know how it feels to do this, but if I were one, I wouldn't like to type /leave every time i get auto assigned to a team.
